findings.does_not_imply: A short prediction-label shift optimum does not establish an indexing bug.

findings.name: final model input
findings.status: verified for five fixed training frames
findings.fact: Actual RLDSBatchTransform vs actual predict_action final-input boundary: both vision tensors max difference0; all102 tokens identical; no instruction truncation. Image/loader source files match training commit.
findings.scope_limit: No trained forward was run by this test; deterministic no augmentation; separate prior HTTP fixture check covers transport.

findings.name: vectorized training memory implementation
findings.fact: Original vs optimized outputs, gradients and memory contents pass3 tests and4 actual-group16 checks.
findings.scope_limit: This does not validate learned long-history behavior or dense versus sparse sampling.

findings.name: normalization removes action range
findings.status: verified data/contract issue, causal contribution unconfirmed
findings.fact: The training normalization and inference denormalization share q01=q99=1.52 for thumb coordinate7. For all10 fixed forward episodes, final-D grasp-phase targets for arm joints5/7 are clipped by up to0.21496/0.13509rad. The exact frozen training numeric loader confirms those labels.
findings.scope_limit: Cannot conclude no alternate grasp pose exists, or that clipping explains every failure. Do not change original normalization files or call a different inverse a bug fix.

findings.name: ordered six-stage failures
findings.fact: All3 currently closed v1.1 six-of-seven cases are forward, missing D-to-pan; two never Robot-contact D and keep it on pad, one briefly contacts D but never lifts it beyond5.7mm. After phase6 they mostly touch B/C.
findings.scope_limit: Completed-case snapshot is not a balanced final success-rate comparison.

findings.name: archived model fit on actual training RGB
findings.status: two episodes, four frames each only
findings.fact: At empty-history frame0, arm h8 RMSE is about0.050/0.053rad. Raw hand RMSE about0.486rad is mostly normalization projection loss: after matching training normalization inverse it becomes0.00546/0.00509rad.
findings.scope_limit: Do not mislabel the raw hand error as learned underfitting; not a20-episode model-fit study.

report.scope: Read-only construction of frozen actual seven-task chest training numeric loader; current generic latest/three-task helper was rejected and not used

report.interpretation: Constant q01=q99 thumb cannot reconstruct initial 0.01..1.52 ramp. This is shared training/inference normalization, not evidence of wrong deployment stats. Large raw hand RMSE must be separated from this representability loss. Two-episode fixture arm errors remain on training images even after projecting labels.
